name: B10-0226/2024 (Renew) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Azerbaijan to release people it says are held for their political views or human rights work. It names activists, journalists and media outlets it says are being repressed, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli and Meydan TV staff. It asks the European Union to sanction Azerbaijani officials responsible for serious human rights violations and to suspend energy agreements with Azerbaijan. It also insists that human rights conditions in EU-Azerbaijan agreements be fully carried out. This is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands the release of named prisoners and an end to repression of independent media.
- It calls for EU sanctions on responsible officials and suspension of energy deals with Azerbaijan.
- The resolution is sent to EU institutions and Azerbaijani authorities; it does not itself change law.
